title: VCAP Verification Callback
description: The most critical VCAP message. Sent by the verifier to the marketplace after completing verification. Triggers escrow settlement.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

verification_id.description: Must match the verification_id from the corresponding verification_request.

passed.description: True if verification succeeded (delivery confirmed). False if verification failed (delivery rejected).

proof_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical proof bundle (sorted JSON, no whitespace, UTF-8, no trailing newline).

proof_signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the canonical proof body, signed with the marketplace-verifier shared secret.

extracted_content.description: OPTIONAL truncated content extracted from the target URL during verification.

failure_reason.description: OPTIONAL human-readable reason why verification failed. Present when passed is false.

action_log.description: Sequential log of all actions the verifier took. Must be non-empty.

index.description: Zero-based sequential order of this action in the log.

action.description: Action type from the VCAP action registry.

url.description: OPTIONAL URL this action was performed against.

selector.description: OPTIONAL CSS selector used by this action.

cost_cents.description: Billing cost of this action in cents. Free actions have cost_cents of 0.

duration_ms.description: OPTIONAL wall-clock duration of this action in milliseconds.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this action was executed.

data_snippet.description: OPTIONAL first N characters of data extracted by this action.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the verifier finished and the callback was sent.
